The '''Ion bomb''' was reputed by [[Qui-Gon Jinn/Legends|Qui-Gon Jinn]] to be the most destructive explosive in [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]]. Boxes of ion bombs stored around a planet exploding at the same time; the reaction could destroy a planet.<ref name="Dark Rival">''[[Jedi Apprentice: The Dark Rival]]''</ref> It was a bomb that used ion energy to disrupt electronics and cause malfunctions.

They were primitive but very effective. They were mainly for use in atmospheric combat, due to the fin-stabilized guidance system.<ref name="Starships of the Galaxy Saga Edition">[[Starships of the Galaxy (Saga Edition)|''Starships of the Galaxy'', Saga Edition]]</ref>

In [[137 ABY]] ion bombs were used aboard [[drone ship]]s during [[Evacuation of Dac]].<ref name="Legacy 47">[[Legacy (2006) 47|''Legacy'' (2006) 47]]</ref>
